outcome: Expression of SQLE and FDPS genes
cohort: The study utilized placentas from 11 normal term pregnancies as the source of STBEVs, which were then applied to a hepatocarcinoma cell line (HepG2 cells).
finding: STBEVs carry apolipoprotein-E (apoE) and, upon uptake by HepG2 liver cells via apoE-LDL receptor interaction, increase lipid synthesis through increased cholesterol release, upregulation of SQLE and FDPS genes, and downregulation of the CLOCK gene.
